uxNotes: Cancelling a membership (Kündigen) and issuing a new member card (invalidates the old one) run without confirmation, while 'Rücklastschrift' asks.
Trash is only offered when no dues exist, with no hint why the ⋯ menu is missing otherwise.
Dues on a phone sit below 5 form cards; status of payments is only summarised in the meta line.
Pause and cancel are separate cards with own submit buttons next to a SaveBar form – three save mechanisms on one page.
No 'storniert' (cancel a due) button in the UI although the action accepts status=cancelled.

redesign.job: One membership at a glance: state, open dues, paid until, the next step (collect / mark paid); settle dues; pause, cancel, card.
redesign.phone: ‹ Mitglieder · name. Header: state badge, meta Nr · type. Stats (2 per row): Offen, Bezahlt bis, Mitglied seit, Beitrag. Round/primary = next step (Bezahlt for the oldest open due, or Lastschrift when it is collected by SEPA, else Bearbeiten). Then Beiträge (rows: text, due, amount, status; Bezahlt button + row ⋯), Angaben (DetailList), Person, Mitgliedskarte, other memberships, Dateien. ⋯ holds Zum Kontakt, Bearbeiten, Pausieren / Pause beenden, Kündigen, Erinnern, Neue Karte, Papierkorb.
redesign.desktop: RecordLayout: left = Stats, Beiträge, Angaben; right = Person (contact link, mail, phone), Mitgliedskarte, Weitere Mitgliedschaften, Dateien. Header: Zum Kontakt + Bearbeiten (outline), ⋯, primary next step.

pages.phone: Three outline header buttons + primary move to the top bar; bulk mark-paid/remind unavailable on phones (cards without tick boxes).
uxNotes: No search on the dues list (can't find one person's dues here; only via their membership page).
Status filter chips sit below the runs card, right-aligned and separated from the table toolbar pattern used elsewhere.
Header holds 3 outline actions + primary + ⋯; 'Beiträge erzeugen' (primary) vs 'Umlage' vs 'SEPA-Lastschrift' are all 'create' flows in sheets that use a plain SubmitButton, not SaveBar.
'Verwerfen' of a SEPA run has no confirm while 'Als eingezogen markieren' has.
No settings gear here, although members and types pages have one; SEPA creditor data needed for runs lives in /members/settings.

redesign.job: Treasurer: what is open / overdue, collect it (SEPA file → bank → mark collected), mark paid, remind; once a year generate the period fees.
redesign.phone: Top bar: Beiträge, ⋯ (gear, SEPA-Lastschrift, Erinnern, Umlage, Export), round + = Beiträge erzeugen. Stats: Offen, Überfällig, Rücklastschriften. Open SEPA runs as step cards (1 XML herunterladen · 2 bei der Bank hochladen · 3 Als eingezogen markieren). Toolbar: search, Segments Offen · Rücklastschrift · Bezahlt · Storniert · Alle. Cards: name + status, text, due date, amount.
redesign.desktop: Header: gear, SEPA-Lastschrift + Erinnern (outline), ⋯ (Umlage, Export), primary Beiträge erzeugen. Stats row, SEPA runs section (open runs as steps, earlier runs as a compact list), <ListToolbar> search · Segments. Table: Name (+ text), Fällig am, Status, Betrag (right). Bulk: Bezahlt, Erinnern, Export (all confirm except export).
